about_the_game:
Feign - Starter Pack

Specially designed for players stepping into the world of Feign, the Starter Pack is perfect for those who want to personalize their experience and show off their style right from the first game.

Pack Contents:

  • 4 different loungewear costumes

  • 7 head costumes

  • 8 face costumes

  • 200 in-game gold

With this pack, you can customize your character and make your first steps in the game more powerful and eye-catching. It also grants access to costumes that are no longer obtainable in the game.
